label: Phoenix Contact FL SWITCH 2306-2SFP (6x 1G RJ45 + 2x SFP)
description: 6 x RJ45 10/100/1000 Mbps plus 2 x SFP 100/1000 Mbps fibre cages, DIN-rail managed switch (item 2702970, Managed Switch 2000 series). Family-wide: DIN rail, IP20, -40 to +70 C, 12-57 V DC supply, PROFINET Conformance Class B, IEC 62443-4-2 certified.
notes: Port census from the datasheet interface block: "Ethernet (RJ45): No. of channels 6 (RJ45 ports), Transmission speed 10/100/1000 Mbps" and "Ethernet (SFP): Number of interfaces 2, No. of channels 2 (SFP ports), Transmission speed 100/1000 Mbps (full duplex), Transmission length up to 80 km depending on the SFP module". Eight data ports in total, 45 mm wide. Switch functions: MAC address table 8k, VLAN up to 32 VLANs, IGMP snooping/querier v1/v2, QoS 8 priority classes, DHCP client / DHCP server (pool-based and port-based) / DHCP option 82 / BootP / DCP, MRP client and manager, RSTP, FRD, Large Tree Support, LACP, PROFINET S2 system redundancy, SNTP, jumbo frames max 9600 bytes, MMS/GOOSE (IEC 61850-8-1), Modbus/TCP. Management: web (HTTP/HTTPS), CLI over Telnet and SSH, SNMPv1/v2/v3, RMON History, LLDP, SNMP traps, N:1 port mirroring, ACD, syslog; port security MAC-based, RADIUS (IEEE 802.1X), MAC Authentication Bypass. Electrical: 24 V DC redundant, range 12-57 V DC, typical current 280 mA at 24 V DC, max 1.5 A, max power dissipation 9 W, alarm digital output 24 V DC / max 0.7 A for 1 minute. No PoE: the datasheet lists no PoE/PSE interface and no power budget for this model, so no poe-pse capability is declared. Management is in-band only - the datasheet interfaces block lists Ethernet (RJ45), Ethernet (SFP) and Ethernet (combo) and nothing else, so no serial/console port is modelled. The datasheet publishes no switching-capacity / fabric-bandwidth figure, so none is stated here. Sources: datasheet https://www.phoenixcontact.com/us/products/2702970?type=pdf ; product page https://www.phoenixcontact.com/us/products/2702970.
